scenarios.precondition: Rolequiry is open with no imported OpenAI case.

messages.content: Import the official OpenAI Forward Deployed Engineer, Seoul posting into Rolequiry as testable employer claims. Do not infer my priorities yet.

argumentRules: claims contains 1 to 8 non-empty employer claims
claims omit kind, coverage, status, unresolvedness, tension and ranking

scenarios.precondition: The OpenAI case is imported and get_role_claims has returned the four claim IDs.

messages.content: My travel ceiling is about 20 percent, technical authority matters, and I prefer hands-on work but can accept a flexible coding mix. Propose priorities first; do not write them until I confirm.
I confirm: Travel CRITICAL, Hands-on coding MEDIUM, Technical authority HIGH, Concurrent deployments MEDIUM.

argumentRules: priorities uses claim IDs returned by get_role_claims
the four importance values exactly match the confirmed mapping
no raw career narrative or rationale is included
observablePass: all four controls show candidate-confirmed priorities
activeProbeId remains null after the write

scenarios.precondition: Candidate A priorities are confirmed and no probe is active.

messages.content: Which uncertainty should change my decision next?

argumentRules: the tool takes an empty object
the returned claim_id, unresolved_variable and measurable_form become the sole research target
observablePass: ranking becomes visible only after selection

messages.content: Research only the active Travel question. Attempt to find credible counterevidence. Record a source only if it resolves this claim; preserve uncertainty when it does not.

expectedCalls.condition: only when a credible claim-specific source exists

forbiddenCalls: recording arbitrary news or analyst commentary
argumentRules: stance is NEUTRAL when material is mixed or non-resolving
sourceUrl, sourceLabel and summary refer to the same source
observablePass: evidence is attached only to Travel when recorded
weak material is neutral or unrecorded

scenarios.precondition: One claim is active and the candidate supplies a real hiring-manager answer.

messages.content: The hiring manager told me the team typically travels two weeks per quarter, with occasional longer launches. Record this answer against the question we are currently checking.

forbiddenCalls: attaching the answer to a non-active claim
argumentRules: stance reflects whether the answer supports, challenges or leaves the active claim neutral
observablePass: only the active claim gains candidate-specific evidence

scenarios.precondition: Rolequiry starts from a fresh case tab and the official role page is available.

messages.content: Use the official OpenAI Seoul FDE role and my 20 percent travel ceiling to build a Rolequiry case. Ask before writing priorities, investigate only the selected uncertainty, and finish with what I should verify next.
I confirm the proposed mapping. Continue.

argumentRules: later calls reuse claim IDs and active-probe output from earlier calls
research stays inside the selected claim
final guidance uses the measurable form or remaining unknown
observablePass: the UI and tool outputs represent one shared case
the final response distinguishes employer claim, evidence and unknown
the final response gives a falsifiable verification question
